column3: The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “Who can find one who has not been satisfied with his meat,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“To the path” is rendered “to the traveler,” following a change of vowels.
“Who will give” is rendered “Oh that,” and “my mark” as “my signature.” “The person of my case” is rendered “my adversary.”
“Caused to breathe out the life” is rendered “caused … to lose their lives.”
